scenarios.title: Bleeding neck hematoma, airway narrowing
scenarios.presentation: Arrives by ambulance with an expanding neck hematoma from an actively bleeding carotid injury; the airway is narrowing. The ED physician has documented the emergency condition and requested the on-call vascular surgeon for operative exploration and repair.
scenarios.onCall: Dr. M. Okafor, on-call vascular surgeon (fictional)
scenarios.acceptNote: Accepts. Leaving home now, in the OR within 25 minutes.
scenarios.procedureNote: Neck exploration with direct carotid repair completed. Airway secured. Transferred to ICU.

without.finding: An actively bleeding carotid hematoma was narrowing the patient's airway. The on-call vascular surgeon would not come in.

scenarios.title: Bilateral jaw fractures
scenarios.presentation: Arrives with bilateral mandible fractures after an assault. The ED physician has documented the emergency condition and requested the on-call oral and maxillofacial surgeon for open reduction and fixation.
scenarios.onCall: Dr. S. Lindqvist, on-call oral and maxillofacial surgeon (fictional)
scenarios.acceptNote: Accepts. Booking the OR for first available slot tonight.
scenarios.procedureNote: Open reduction and internal fixation of bilateral mandible fractures completed. Admitted to the surgical ward.

without.finding: The on-call oral and maxillofacial surgeon declined a patient with bilateral jaw fractures.

scenarios.title: Femur fracture, patient transferred before incision
scenarios.presentation: Arrives with an open femoral shaft fracture. The ED physician has documented the emergency condition and requested the on-call orthopaedic surgeon. Before incision, associated injuries lead the treating physicians to transfer the patient to a Level I trauma center that accepts the transfer.
scenarios.onCall: Dr. P. Anand, on-call orthopaedic surgeon (fictional)
scenarios.acceptNote: Accepts. Preparing the OR while the transfer is confirmed.
scenarios.procedureNote: Procedure not performed. Patient transferred to a Level I trauma center by physician decision before incision.
